benchmark_contract.backend: Triton paged BF16 CSA sparse GQA
benchmark_contract.performance_scope: step15 rank0/rank1 fitted index draws at two evaluator-private index seeds; the standard evaluator geometric mean over all four shapes is the objective
benchmark_contract.correctness_scope: the same four step15 single-request fitted-index shapes used for performance

tolerance_calibration.method: piped reference-vs-Triton elementwise diff on the GPU gateway
tolerance_calibration.note: the legacy atol of 0.01 is about six times the largest possible output magnitude (1.6e-3), so an elementwise gate at that value cannot fail; the calibrated atol is 3.2e-5 with rtol 0.02, a 2-20x margin over observation

input_semantics.cp_partition: each 8192-token scheduler chunk is split into 4096 contiguous query rows per CP rank
input_semantics.cache_layout: K/V views share interleaved storage; shape [2626,128,2,256], stride [2157376,512,256,1]
input_semantics.selected_prefix_contract: 512 selected completed groups expand to 2048 tokens and the 0..3-token incomplete causal tail follows immediately; valid_count bounds the non-negative prefix
input_semantics.performance_data: self-contained fitted step-15 index law; no private tensor ships with the problem
input_semantics.index_seed: selects one draw of the fitted step-15 index law; development seeds are public in shape_train.json, scored seeds are withheld in shape_valid.json
input_semantics.scored_data: all four scored cases use the self-contained fitted_step15 law and are both correctness-checked and timed

matched: adjacent-row group overlap 480 of 512 (exact on both ranks)
recency profile: 0.509/0.523 of selections within the newest 512 groups
pages per row median 51/50 against measured 49/48
hotspot concentration: top 1% of groups take about 16% of selections
rank1 trailing regime rows including their page footprint (354 vs 365 pages)
known_deviations: launch-level distinct pages 310 vs 282 (rank0) and 298 vs 280 (rank1 main rows)
launch-level distinct groups about 8-17% above measured

adjacent overlap across a completed_groups boundary is 416-418 vs 478: the relative-offset model must shift ids at a boundary while production keeps absolute ids, so the synthetic churns about twice as often there
index_law_fidelity.deviation_direction: the residual deviations make cross-row KV reuse look *less* valuable than in production, so they do not reward over-specializing on the synthetic draw
